project_name: Agentic AI System for Data Pipeline Incident Investigation
descriptor: A system coordinating specialized agents to analyze data-engineering pipeline incidents, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions.

requirements.statement: The system must analyze error logs for common patterns to determine the root cause of pipeline incidents.
The system must coordinate specialized agents to analyze pipeline dependencies.
The system must analyze SQL queries to identify potential issues.
The system must analyze data-quality issues to identify potential root causes.
The system must recommend corrective actions for human approval.
The system must flag uncertain root causes and notify the user.
The system must provide simplified summaries for ops teams.
The system must connect to data sources for log and SQL analysis.
The system must reduce incident investigation time from 4 hours to 1 hour.
The system must ensure recommendations for major changes are reviewed before approval.
The system must log all investigation activities for audit purposes.
The system must have a successful pilot with low error rates before autonomous operation.
Every screen the ops team uses must complete its primary action in three clicks or fewer.
The system must support integration with existing ops tools for notifications.
The system must allow configuration of agent parameters by data engineers.
The system must handle concurrent investigations without performance degradation.
The system must provide detailed reports of investigation outcomes.
The system must support role-based access control for security.

releases.demo: Show a basic investigation from log analysis to recommendation with audit logging.
releases.goal: Establish the basic end-to-end investigation path with trust spine.
releases.name: Initial Skeleton

releases.demo: Demonstrate SQL and data-quality analysis contributing to root cause identification.
releases.goal: Add SQL and data-quality analysis capabilities.
releases.name: Enhanced Analysis

releases.demo: Show recommendations being generated and flagged notifications for uncertain cases.
releases.goal: Implement recommendation engine and notification system.
releases.name: Recommendation and Notification

releases.demo: Present simplified summaries and detailed reports to ops teams.
releases.goal: Develop user interface and reporting features.
releases.name: User Interface and Reporting

releases.demo: Showcase a successful pilot with reduced investigation time and low error rates.
releases.goal: Conduct pilot testing and optimize performance.
releases.name: Pilot Testing and Optimization

stories.title: Basic Log Analysis and Recommendation
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want the system to analyze logs and recommend corrective actions, so that I can quickly address pipeline incidents.
acceptance: Given a pipeline incident, when logs are analyzed, then a recommendation is generated.
Given a log with no common patterns, when analyzed, then no recommendation is generated.
Trust: All log analysis activities are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement log analysis module and connect to logging data source.

stories.title: Audit Logging for Investigations
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want all investigation activities logged, so that I can audit them later.
acceptance: Given an investigation, when it is conducted, then all activities are logged.
Given a failed investigation, when it is logged, then failure details are included.
Trust: Logs are immutable and timestamped.
stories.task_guidance: Set up audit logging framework and ensure all investigation steps are logged.

stories.title: SQL Analysis for Root Cause Identification
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want the system to analyze SQL queries, so that potential issues can be identified.
acceptance: Given a SQL query, when analyzed, then potential issues are identified.
Given a SQL query with no issues, when analyzed, then no issues are reported.
Trust: SQL analysis results are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop SQL analysis module and integrate with SQL data source.

stories.title: Data-Quality Analysis for Root Cause Identification
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want the system to analyze data-quality issues, so that root causes can be identified.
acceptance: Given data-quality metrics, when analyzed, then root causes are identified.
Given data with no quality issues, when analyzed, then no root causes are reported.
Trust: Data-quality analysis results are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data-quality analysis module and connect to data-quality metrics source.

stories.title: Recommendation Engine with Human Approval
stories.narrative: As an ops team member, I want recommendations to be approved by humans, so that major changes are verified.
acceptance: Given a recommendation, when it is major, then it requires human approval.
Given a minor recommendation, when generated, then it is auto-approved.
Trust: All recommendations and approvals are logged.
stories.task_guidance: Develop recommendation engine and approval workflow.

stories.title: Notification System for Uncertain Cases
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want the system to notify me of uncertain cases, so that I can review them.
acceptance: Given an uncertain root cause, when identified, then a notification is sent.
Given a certain root cause, when identified, then no notification is sent.
Trust: Notifications are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement notification system and integrate with existing ops tools.

stories.title: User Interface for Ops Teams
stories.narrative: As an ops team member, I want a user-friendly interface, so that I can efficiently manage and monitor system operations.
acceptance: Given an ops team member, when accessing the dashboard, then the primary action completes in three clicks or fewer.
Given an ops team member, when using the interface, then response times are under 2 seconds for any action.
Trust: Given any user action, when logged, then the audit trail records the action with a timestamp.
failure_paths: Interface takes more than three clicks for primary actions
Audit trail fails to log actions
stories.task_guidance: Implement the UI using the existing design framework, ensuring all primary actions are accessible within three clicks. Optimize backend queries to maintain response times under 2 seconds.

stories.title: Detailed Reporting of Investigation Outcomes
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want detailed reports of investigation outcomes, so that I can analyze them further.
acceptance: Given an investigation, when completed, then a detailed report is generated.
Given a failed investigation, when reported, then failure details are included.
Trust: Reports are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop reporting module and ensure integration with investigation data.

stories.title: Pilot Testing and Performance Optimization
stories.narrative: As a project manager, I want a successful pilot test, so that the system can operate autonomously.
acceptance: Given a pilot test, when conducted, then error rates are low.
Given a pilot test, when completed, then investigation time is reduced to 1 hour.
Trust: Pilot test results are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Conduct pilot testing and optimize system performance.

stories.title: Coordinate Specialized Agents for Dependency Analysis
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to coordinate specialized agents, so that pipeline dependencies are analyzed efficiently.
acceptance: Given a set of pipeline dependencies, when agents are coordinated, then the analysis completes successfully.
Given a failure in agent coordination, when retried, then the system recovers without data loss.
Trust: Given any coordination task, when executed, then the audit trail logs the task with a timestamp.
failure_paths: Audit trail fails to log coordination tasks
stories.task_guidance: Develop a coordination module that interfaces with existing agents to analyze pipeline dependencies. Ensure robust error handling and logging.
